description: This file contains implementation of system tick timer initialization and start functions for different PowerPC-based microcontrollers, including specific configurations for MPC560X and MPC5604P, as well as generic PowerPC setup. It includes interrupt service routines and hardware register manipulations related to system tick handling in an AUTOSAR platform.

methods.name: Os_SysTick_MPC560x
methods.description: Interrupt handler for MPC560X series to clear API interrupt and call OsTick.

methods.name: Os_SysTick_MPC5xxx_PIT
methods.description: Interrupt handler for MPC5604P to clear PIT interrupt and call OsTick.

methods.name: Os_SysTickInit
methods.description: Initializes the system tick timer with appropriate interrupt service routine based on configuration.

methods.name: Os_SysTickStart
methods.description: Starts the system tick timer with specified period in ticks, configuring hardware registers for different platforms.
